propositions: Cloud's three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) lack test coverage for multi-page pagination and only exercise single-page termination

The cursor pagination contract in acli_graph.py uses opaque nextPageToken with dual termination conditions (isLast flag or absent token) but has no test asserting cursor advancement, token echoing, or both stop conditions independently
A repeated cursor token causes these readers to loop forever with fail-open error swallowing, producing silently partial maps, distinct from fetcher._iter_pages which has a same-token-twice guard
New test module with 521 lines drives all three readers against 250-item seeded dataset across 3 pages, asserting set recovery, cursor token advance in request bodies, and independent stop conditions
Mutation testing confirms the regression net catches six independent defect classes including short-page breaks (DC defect transplanted to Cloud) and stop-condition omissions
